prompt: An unknown absorbs at λmax = 217 nm (ε ≈ 20,000). What is it most likely to be?

options.label: An isolated C=C (λmax < 190 nm, too short wavelength)
A conjugated diene (λmax ~215 nm is textbook for 1,3-butadiene)
An aromatic ring (λmax ~255 nm, more structure)
A saturated ketone (λmax ~280 nm, low ε)

explanation: Conjugated dienes absorb strongly at 210-230 nm (π→π* for the lowered-energy excited state). Isolated alkenes are below 190 nm. Benzene is ~255 nm with fine structure. Simple carbonyls are weak at 280 nm (n→π*).
